newsitem.title: USA: Inter-Regional Fin'l to sell two bond funds.
newsitem.headline: Inter-Regional Fin'l to sell two bond funds.

text.p: Inter-Regional Financial Group Inc said Wednesday that the board of Great Hall Investment Funds Inc approved the sale of its two tax-exempt bond funds to Voyageur Fund Managers Inc.

Shareholders of the Great Hall Minnesota Insured Tax-Exempt Fund and Great Hall National Tax-Exempt Fund will exchange their shares for shares of equal value of Voyageur Minnesota Insured Fund and Voyageur National High Yield Municipal Fund.
The combined assets of the two Great Hall funds is $89 million.
Each transaction is subject to approval of the Great Hall Fund's shareholders. Meetings have been scheduled for November 6.

"The proposed transfers are consistent with Inter-Regional's strategy of selling to retail clients mutual funds that are managed by other firms," said J. Scott Spiker, executive vice president of Inter-Regional Financial.
Voyageur Funds are managed by Voyageur Fund Managers Inc, a subsidiary of Dougherty Financial Group Inc.
